overall_summary: Data reveals clear divergence: high-sample 'self respect' and digital-detachment digital micro-stories perform decently (averaging 15-40 views), while a sudden experiment into universal family emotional tropes (Maa, Papa, Bhai) generated higher outlier views (50-200 views). However, the core channel identity 'Dil Ki Diary' relies on romantic/overthinking/self-respect niches. We must balance the proven core topic repeatable patterns with the audience's apparent appetite for raw family emotional hooks.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'चैट डिलीट करने की हिम्मत' (41 views) and 'जब आर्काइव फोल्डर पर नजर पड़ी' (23 views) performed well relative to channel baseline.
winning_patterns.action: Continue focusing on micro-actions related to phone/digital habits and self-respect boundaries.

winning_patterns.evidence: Outlier videos about parents like 'माँ जब पूछती है खाना खाया' scored 203 views with 18 likes.
winning_patterns.action: Use a small experiment budget to test family-centric emotional bonds framed around personal sacrifice.

weak_patterns.evidence: Abstract thoughts like 'रात के ख्याल और अधूरा इंतजार' (6 views) or changing ringtones ('जब उसका स्पेशल रिंगटोन बदल कर' - 3 views) lacked strong physical triggers.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid abstract heartbreak; anchor every story in a specific tangible, physical item or everyday notification.
